steps.title: Fix tissues in formalin
steps.instruction: Fix tissues with either 10 % (v/v) neutral‑buffered formalin (NBF) or 4 % (w/v) formaldehyde (PFA) for 12–24 h at 4 °C, using a fixative volume 5–10 × the tissue volume and ensuring the tissue is completely covered; maximum fixation time after removal is 4 h. After fixation, tissues may be stored in 70 % ethanol at 4 °C. Recommended fixation is 14–15 h at 4 °C; formaldehyde penetrates ~1 mm/h and specimens should not exceed 1.5 × 1.5 × 0.4 cm.

steps.title: Orient tissues in cassettes
steps.instruction: Locate the fixed tissues and place them in embedding cassettes in the desired orientation (e.g., cut primary melanoma tumors vertically to capture tumor‑body to invasive‑front transition).

steps.title: Paraffin‑embed tissues
steps.instruction: Process tissues for paraffin embedding over a total of 16 h using a 600 mL glass container, performing each step under a fume hood:

steps.title: Trim blocks and cut sections
steps.instruction: Trim paraffin blocks as needed and cut sections at 4–5 µm thickness with a microtome (sections must be <5 µm to ensure antibody penetration).

steps.title: Expand sections in water bath
steps.instruction: Place the paraffin ribbon in a water bath set to ~35–40 °C to allow tissue expansion.

steps.title: Mount sections on slides
steps.instruction: Pick the expanded sections from the water bath onto glass slides, store the slides upright in a slide rack.

steps.title: Dry and bake slides
steps.instruction: Air‑dry slides for 14–15 h at 21–25 °C, then bake in an oven at 60 °C for 1 h. Slides may be kept at 21–25 °C for up to 3 months (longer storage may affect antigenicity).

steps.title: Create QuPath project and import images
steps.instruction: Open QuPath, create a new project, and import the composite images for all cases.

steps.title: Set image type and channel colors
steps.instruction: Change each image type to “Fluorescence”. Manually assign colors: Channel 1 = Blue, Channel 2 = Green (CD206), Channel 3 = Red (PD‑L1).

steps.title: Annotate regions of interest
steps.instruction: Create annotations covering the regions of interest in each case (annotations are required before any segmentation or analysis).

steps.title: Detect cells and set thresholds
steps.instruction: Run Cell detection using Channel 2 (green, CD206) as the detection channel. Set the score compartment to “Channel 3: Cell Mean” (red, PD‑L1) and apply intensity thresholds: +1 = 30, +2 = 50, +3 = 70. Adjust score compartment (Cell, Cytoplasm, or Nuclear) and thresholds as needed for the antigen; use Histoscore (0–300) for quantification (intensity grades 0‑3 multiplied by % positive cells).

steps.title: Export measurements and plot H‑score
steps.instruction: Export the “Annotation measurement” table, then plot H‑score results as box‑plots (median, inter‑quartile range, min‑max whiskers, individual mouse points) and perform ANOVA with Yekutieli correction.

steps.title: Record Fiji macro for color deconvolution
steps.instruction: In Fiji‑ImageJ, open Plugins → Macros → Record, select the image of interest, run “Color Deconvolution” with the command: run("Color Deconvolution", "vectors= [H AEC]"); then save the generated macro.

steps.title: Create and run QuPath workflow script
steps.instruction: Use a control image to optimise cell segmentation and intensity thresholds. In QuPath’s Workflow tab, create a new workflow, keep only the commands “Set Image type”, “Select objects by class”, and “Positive Cell Detection”, deleting any earlier Positive Cell Detection steps. Then create the following script, store it, and run it on the whole project:

substeps.instruction: runPlugin('qupath.imagej.detect.cells.PositiveCellDetection', '{"detectionImage": "Channel 2", "backgroundRadius": 13.0, "medianRadius": 0.0, "sigma": 3.0, "minArea": 30.0, "maxArea": 1000.0, "threshold": 32.0, "watershedPostProcess": true, "cellExpansion": 5.0, "includeNuclei": true, "smoothBoundaries": true, "makeMeasurements": false, "thresholdCompartment": "Cell: Channel 3 mean", "thresholdPositive1": 30.0, "thresholdPositive2": 50.0, "thresholdPositive3": 70.0, "singleThreshold": false}');
